{{MedalSport|Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|{{bk|SRB}}}} {{Medal|Competition|[[EuroBasket]]}} {{Medal|Silver|[[EuroBasket 2017|2017 Finland–Israel–Romania–Turkey]]|}} }} '''Ognjen Kuzmić''' ({{lang-sr-Cyrl|Огњен Кузмић}}, {{IPA|sr|ǒɡɲen kûzmit͡ɕ|pron}}; born May 16, 1990) is a Serbian former professional [[basketball]] player. He has also represented the senior [[Serbia national basketball team|Serbian national team]] in international competition. Standing at {{height|m=2.13}}, he played at the [[Center (basketball)|center]] position. He was selected with the 52nd overall pick in the [[2012 NBA draft]] by the [[Golden State Warriors]] and won the [[2015 NBA Finals|2015 NBA Championship]] with the same team. ==Professional career== Kuzmić started his senior career in [[OKK Borac|Borac Banja Luka]] and the first basketball steps began in Findo Doboj. After one season, he left to play for [[Korihait]] in the [[Korisliiga|Finnish league]]. In 2010, he returned to Bosnia to play for [[KK Čelik|KK Čelik Zenica]]. In 2011, he signed with [[Baloncesto Málaga|Unicaja Málaga]] but played the 2011–12 season with farm team, [[CB Axarquía|Clínicas Rincón Benahavís]] of the [[Liga Española de Baloncesto|Spanish Second League]]. He also played two games with Unicaja. In 2012, Unicaja Málaga loaned him to [[Joventut Badalona]].[http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/spain/94839/badalona-adds-size-with-ognjen-kuzmic.html Badalona adds size with Ognjen Kuzmic] On September 27, 2013, he signed with the [[Golden State Warriors]].[https://www.nba.com/warriors/news/kuzmic-alexander_092713 Warriors Sign 2012 Second Round Pick Ognjen Kuzmic to Contract] During his rookie and sophomore seasons, he had multiple assignments with the [[Santa Cruz Warriors]] of the [[NBA G League|NBA Development League]],{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2013_14.html |title=2013-14 NBA Assignments |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=2014-01-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140703151241/http://www.nba.com/dleague/assignments_2013_14.html |archive-date=2014-07-03 |url-status=dead }}[http://dleague.nba.com/news/assignments/ 2014-15 NBA Assignments] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150628235947/http://dleague.nba.com/news/assignments/ |date=June 28, 2015 }} earning a mention to the All-NBA Development League Defensive Third Team and winning a D-League championship during the 2014–15 season.{{cite news|title=NBA Development League Announces 2014-15 All-League Teams|url=http://dleague.nba.com/news/nba-development-league-announces-2014-15-all-league-teams/|access-date=April 26, 2015|work=NBA.com|date=April 22, 2015|archive-date=April 26, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150426012519/http://dleague.nba.com/news/nba-development-league-announces-2014-15-all-league-teams/|url-status=dead}}{{cite news|title=Title Wave: Santa Cruz Wins NBA D-League Championship|url=http://dleague.nba.com/games/20150426/FWNSCW/|access-date=April 26, 2015|work=NBA.com|date=April 26, 2015}} To add to his D-League title, he was part of Golden State's championship winning team who defeated the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]] in the [[2015 NBA Finals]]. Kuzmić failed to appear in any post-season action due to a recurring left ankle injury.[http://fantasynews.cbssports.com/fantasybasketball/update/25189040/warriors-c-ognjen-kuzmic-cleared-to-play-in-conference-finals Warriors C Ognjen Kuzmic cleared to play in conference finals] On July 27, 2015, he signed a two-year deal with the Greek club [[Panathinaikos B.C.|Panathinaikos]].{{cite news|title=Panathinaikos inks center Kuzmic to two-year deal|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/68cn7w7bcb3fqymd/panathinaikos-inks-center-kuzmic-to-two-year-deal|access-date=27 July 2015|work=Euroleague.net|date=27 July 2015}} On April 21, 2016, he left PAO.{{cite news|title=Kuzmic and Pavlovic replaced and released|url=https://www.eurohoops.net/heba/229745/kuzmic-and-pavlovic-replaced-and-released|access-date=21 April 2016|work=Eurohoops.net|date=21 April 2016}} On July 19, 2016, Kuzmić signed a three-year contract with [[KK Crvena zvezda|Crvena zvezda]].{{cite news|title=Novi centar Crvene zvezde - Ognjen Kuzmić!|url=http://www.kkcrvenazvezda.rs/novi-centar-crvene-zvezde---ognjen-kuzmic-19-07-2016.html|access-date=20 July 2016|work=kkcrvenazvezda.rs|date=19 July 2016|language=sr|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160723171535/http://kkcrvenazvezda.rs/novi-centar-crvene-zvezde---ognjen-kuzmic-19-07-2016.html|archive-date=23 July 2016|url-status=dead}} Kuzmić was named [[EuroLeague MVP of the Month|MVP for the month of January]] in the [[2016–17 EuroLeague]] season.{{cite news|title=Turkish Airlines EuroLeague MVP for January: Ognjen Kuzmic, Crvena Zvezda mts Belgrade|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/cups/euroleague/224626/turkish-airlines-euroleague-mvp-for-january-ognjen-kuzmic-crvena-zvezda-mts-belgrade.html|access-date=16 April 2017|date=30 January 2017}} On July 26, 2017, Kuzmić signed a two-year deal with [[Real Madrid Baloncesto|Real Madrid]].{{cite news|title=Real Madrid lands center Kuzmic|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/7xpr7gq53rg84vi7|access-date=26 July 2017|work=Euroleague.net|date=26 July 2017}} In October 2017, he tore the [[Anterior cruciate ligament injury|ACL]] in his left knee and was sidelined for the rest of the season.{{cite news|title=Madrid's Kuzmic out long term|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/89x6olmlxqu43n7d/madrid-s-kuzmic-out-long-term|access-date=2 May 2018|work=euroleague.net|date=20 October 2017}} He returned on the court in 2018–19 season, but soon injured his right ankle and missed considerable time.{{cite news |title=Ognen Kuzmic still out due to ankle injury |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/euroleague/773890/ognen-kuzmic-still-out-due-to-ankle-injury/ |access-date=14 July 2019 |work=eurohoops.net |date=13 November 2018}} After recovering from injury, he fell out of Real Madrid's rotation and appeared in only 12 games till the end of the season. On July 3, 2019, Kuzmić signed a two-year contract for Crvena zvezda.{{cite web |title=Zvezdin toranj u narednim sezonama – Ognjen Kuzmić! |url=http://www.kkcrvenazvezda.rs/zvezdin-toranj-u-narednim-sezonama-%E2%80%93-ognjen-kuzmic-03-07-2019.html |website=kkcrvenazvezda.rs |access-date=3 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190703214938/http://www.kkcrvenazvezda.rs/zvezdin-toranj-u-narednim-sezonama-%25E2%2580%2593-ognjen-kuzmic-03-07-2019.html |archive-date=3 July 2019 |url-status=dead }}{{cite web |title=Ognjen Kuzmić is back at Crvena zvzeda mts |url=https://www.aba-liga.com/news.php?id=42071 |website=aba-liga.com |access-date=4 July 2019}} On October 24, 2019, Kuzmić made a season debut against [[FC Barcelona Basquet|Barcelona]], less than four months after sustaining severe injuries in [[Ognjen Kuzmić#2019 traffic accident|traffic accident]].{{cite news |title=KOŠARKAŠKO ROĐENJE Emotivni Kuzmić se vratio još jači posle nesreće i poručio navijačima - VERUJTE U OVU EKIPU |url=https://sport.blic.rs/zvezda-evroliga-2019/ognjen-kuzmic-se-vratio-na-teren-izjava-posle-meca-sa-barselonom/b8xthzn |access-date=15 November 2019 |work=blic.rs |language=sr}} In February 2020, he was loaned to [[KK FMP|FMP]] for the rest of the 2019–20 season.{{cite web |title=Zvezda poslala Čovića i Kuzmića u FMP |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2020&mm=02&dd=11&nav_id=1653189 |website=b92.net |access-date=11 February 2020}} On July 27, 2023, Kuzmić renewed his contract through 2025. On Christmas Day 2023, Kuzmić mutually parted ways with the Serbian powerhouse. He ended his professional basketball career on June 24, 2025.{{cite news |last1=Jakovljević |first1=Andrej |title=Ognjen Kuzmić završio karijeru |url=https://nova.rs/sport/kosarka/ognjen-kuzmic-penzija-crvena-zvezda/ |access-date=4 July 2026 |work=nova.rs |date=24 June 2025 |language=Serbian}} ==Career statistics== {{Euroleague player statistics legend}} ===NBA=== {| class="wikitable" |- | style="background:#AFE6BA; Đorđević objavio širi spisak|agency=[[B92]].net|date=6 June 2014|access-date=10 July 2016}} Three weeks later, in early July 2014, Kuzmić further made Đorđević's shortened list of 20 players invited for the training camp,{{cite news|url=https://www.telegraf.rs/sport/1136030-djordjevicevih-20-odabranih-bez-bobija-marjanovica|title=Đorđevićevih 20 odabranih bez Bobija 2014|access-date=10 July 2016}} ===EuroBasket 2015=== The following summer at [[EuroBasket 2015]], Kuzmić represented Serbia for the first time at a major tournament.{{cite news|title=AMBITIOUS SERBIA UNVEIL POWERFUL 12-MAN SQUAD|url=http://www.eurobasket2015.org/en/compID_qMRZdYCZI6EoANOrUf9le2.season_2015.roundID_9322.coid_xUMkR0x,HeIT9w-vv9Ob00.articleMode_on.html|access-date=3 September 5, 2015|website=eurobasket2015.org|publisher=FIBA Europe|access-date=20 September 2015}} ===EuroBasket 2017=== {{see also|2017 Serbia men's EuroBasket team}} Kuzmić also represented Serbia at the [[EuroBasket 2017]] where they won the silver medal, after losing in the final game to [[Slovenia national basketball team|Slovenia]].{{cite news|title=Slovenia overcome injuries to claim historic title in Dragic's swansong|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/eurobasket/2017/news/slovenia-overcome-injuries-to-claim-historic-title|access-date=17 September 2017|work=FIBA.basketball|date=17 September 2017|language=en}} Over 9 tournament games, he averaged 7.1 points, 5.1 rebounds and 1.3 assists per game. On 1 July 2019, Kuzmić was selected to the [[2019 Serbia FIBA Basketball World Cup team|Serbia 18-man preliminary roster]] for the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup]] in China.{{cite web |title=Stars Jokic, Marjanovic, Bogdanovic and Teodosic headline 18-man Serbia squad |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/basketballworldcup/2019/news/stars-jokic-marjanovic-bogdanovic-and-teodosic-headline-18-man-serbia-squad |website=fiba.basketball |access-date=1 July 2019}} On 15 July 2019, he was excluded from consideration due to the unpredictability of the recovery from the traffic accident he had been involved in a day earlier.{{cite web |title=PROMENA na spisku "orlova": Kuzmića menja Jovanović |url=https://mondo.rs/a1203628/Sport/Kosarka/Nikola-Jovanovic-reprezentacija-Srbije-Ognjen-Kuzmic.html |website=mondo.rs |access-date=15 July 2019|language=sr}} [[Nikola Jovanović (basketball, born 1994)|Nikola Jovanović]] was called up in Kuzmić's place. ==Personal life== ===2019 traffic accident=== In the morning hours of 14 July 2019 on the [[Banja Luka]]-[[Prijedor]] state road near the village of [[Ramići, Banja Luka|Ramići]], Kuzmić was involved in a serious [[Traffic collision|traffic accident]]. Driving his [[Porsche Cayenne]] SUV, the twenty-nine-year-old professional basketball player reportedly collided with a BMW vehicle going in the opposite direction while traveling at a high speed.{{cite news |last1=K. |first1=A. |title=Ognjen Kuzmić teško povređen u saobraćajnoj nesreći! |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2019&mm=07&dd=14&nav_id=1566036 |access-date=14 July 2019 |work=b92.net |date=14 July 2019 |language=sr}} He sustained life-threatening injuries in the accident, breaking his [[maxilla]] and [[mandible]] head bones (upper and lower jaws), as well as his [[thorax|chest]].{{cite news |last1=K. |first1=A. |title=Kuzmića zbog ozbiljnosti povreda prebačen u Beograd |url=https://www.b92.net/sport/kosarka/vesti.php?yyyy=2019&mm=07&dd=14&nav_id=1566043 |access-date=14 July 2019 |work=b92.net |date=14 July 2019 |language=sr}} He was immediately placed in [[induced coma]] and airlifted via helicopter to the [[Clinical Centre of Serbia]] in [[Belgrade]]. Reportedly, thirty-year-old Bosnian professional [[Boxing|boxer]] Dražan Janjanin was a passenger in the car that collided with Kuzmić's car.{{cite web |title=ISPOVEST BOKSERA KOJI JE UČESTVOVAO U NESREĆI: Svetla su se odjednom pojavila ispred nas, iz Kuzmićevog auta se čula glasna muzika i krkljanje
